kind: controlled synthetic updater diagnostic; not original benchmark development or validation

research_chain.preceding_evidence: description_factor v1 returned empty deletions for both real metadata stages. This did not distinguish universal abstention from difficulty recognizing safe coverage in those documents.
research_chain.literature_basis: Reuse EasyTool 2401.06201v3 and author JARVIS 7624cf388b47334ff8a0868e7d862dde18cfda86, documented in results/evidence/interface-mechanism-review-20261101/bounded-review.json. The borrowed mechanism is removing redundant tool documentation; the author pipeline consumes prepared instructions in data_process.py and uses staged selection/execution. This project does not import that runtime, examples or training.
research_chain.mechanism_under_test: The unchanged LLM selects whole-line deletions and surviving description/schema coverage. The unchanged compiler verifies indices, literal quotes, field scope and survival of cited content. It does not prove semantic entailment.
research_chain.controlled_intervention: Replace complex real metadata with four constructed identity/near-miss fixtures. Two positive and two negative conditions, each with two fresh calls; same prompt, compiler, model, provider, decoding and updater budget. Expected labels and oracle proposals are evaluator-only.
research_chain.scope: Only updater reliability on these elementary fixtures. No actor, native tool, judge or original task is executed. No result can promote the original candidate.

direct_facts: All eight outputs are structurally valid on the first attempt, with no structural repair or transport retry. All eight requests settled with DigitalOcean; total USD 0.001363560 and no new unknown charge.
Exact-description-duplicate positives pass 2/2; schema-duplicate positives pass 1/2. Combined positives pass 3/4.
Unique-qualifier negatives pass 1/2; schema-near-miss negatives pass 1/2. Combined negatives pass 2/4.

control-01 deletes the unique Amber/Indigo catalogue line and cites unrelated body handling text. Its public JSON reason explicitly says that the catalogue information appears nowhere in the cited line.

control-03 deletes the cedar-specific restriction while citing a maple-specific counterpart. Its public JSON reason ends by recognizing that the deletion is unsafe and saying no deletions, but the executable deletions array remains nonempty.
control-04 deletes the cedar-specific restriction while claiming the whole line is verbatim identical to the schema description. The schema omits that restriction.
The predeclared requirement that all four positives and all four negatives pass is not met. There are three unsafe outputs among eight; no output has been semantically repaired or resampled.
supported_interpretations: Successful duplicate deletions refute universal abstention or inability to express any deletion as an explanation of the previous empty outputs.
Valid literal citations do not guarantee coverage of every removed claim. This diagnostic directly exposes that limitation rather than inferring it from actor scores.

At least two unsafe executable operations contradict their own public rationale. The observed failure includes converting an acknowledged preservation obligation into the output action, not only overlooking a qualifier.
unresolved_or_limited: Two calls per condition do not estimate a stable error rate or establish reproducibility beyond these observations. Temperature zero did not produce identical decisions for three fixtures.
The cause of the two empty real-metadata outputs remains unresolved. These synthetic results cannot establish whether the real metadata contains sufficient safely removable information.
The study does not identify effects on actor completion, product quality, official TF, retention, or their competing causes.

An independent semantic verifier or deterministic exact-coverage guard could change admission decisions, but neither has been tested prospectively here. Applying a new rule to these exposed cases would be post hoc evidence, not fresh validation.

decision.original_description_factor_v1: remains closed; no original candidate promoted
decision.not_generalized_to: all compression methods, all LLM updaters or all selective knowledge adaptation
decision.next_decision_requirement: Before any new model trial, establish from task-free real metadata whether a distinct coverage-validation mechanism has a nontrivial legal intervention to test. Exact-coverage verification and proposal/action consistency are plausible mechanisms, not demonstrated fixes. Do not repeat the current prompt or use control successes as original benchmark evidence.
